description: This PHP source file defines the MainframeModernizationClient class within the Aws\MainframeModernization namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for interacting with the AWS Mainframe Modernization service, including methods for managing applications, environments, and batch jobs.

classes.name: MainframeModernizationClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Mainframe Modernization service, providing asynchronous and synchronous methods for various operations.

methods.name: cancelBatchJobExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a batch job execution.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application in the service.

methods.name: createDataSetImportTask
methods.description: Creates a data set import task.

methods.name: createDataSetImportTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a data set import task.

methods.name: deleteApplicationFromEnvironment
methods.description: Deletes an application from an environment.

methods.name: deleteApplicationFromEnvironmentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an application from an environment.

methods.name: getApplicationVersion
methods.description: Gets a specific version of an application.

methods.name: getBatchJobExecution
methods.description: Retrieves details of a batch job execution.

methods.name: getBatchJobExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves batch job execution details.

methods.name: getDataSetImportTask
methods.description: Gets details of a dataset import task.

methods.name: getDataSetImportTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a dataset import task.

methods.name: getSignedBluinsightsUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a signed URL for Bluinsights.

methods.name: listBatchJobRestartPoints
methods.description: Lists restart points for batch jobs.

methods.name: listBatchJobRestartPointsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists restart points for batch jobs.

methods.name: listDataSetImportHistoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists data set import history.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
